title: 5‑Minute Pre‑Fall Vehicle Checklist
caption: Before the temperature drops, take a few minutes to check your oil, coolant, and tire pressure. A quick walk‑around can keep you on the road and out of the shop. #Saskatoon #MobileMechanic
image_prompt: A hand holding a dipstick under a bright sky, the Saskatoon skyline faintly visible in the background, with a small checklist of vehicle fluids on a clipboard.

title: When you forget to start your car in -30°C
caption: That moment when your car is a frozen ice block. Stay warm, stay prepared—our mobile mechanic comes to you. 😎 #SaskatoonHumor
image_prompt: A cartoon car covered in icicles parked on a snowy Saskatoon street, with a small humorous speech bubble showing a shivering driver.

title: Coffee, Wrenches, and Saskatoon Roads
caption: From early‑morning oil changes to emergency battery boosts, our crew handles it all with a smile. Tag a friend who always needs a quick fix! #MobileMechanic #SaskatoonLife
image_prompt: A mechanic in a bright orange jacket holding a steaming coffee mug, standing next to a fully equipped van on a crisp Saskatoon morning, the city’s downtown visible behind.

title: Don’t Let Brake Issues Catch You Off Guard
caption: With icy streets, proper brake function is essential. If you hear squeaks or feel softness, get it checked before you head out. Our mobile service can be at your home or workplace. #Saskatoon #StaySafe
image_prompt: A close‑up of a mechanic’s gloved hand inspecting brake rotors, icy road glistening in the background, emphasizing the importance of brake safety.

title: Skip the Tow, Keep Moving
caption: Stuck on the side of the road? Our mobile mechanic can come to you, so you avoid an unnecessary tow and get back on the road faster. Convenient, fast, and right here in Saskatoon. #MobileMechanic #NoTow
image_prompt: A mechanic’s van parked beside a car on a snowy street, a distant tow truck visible but idle, the mechanic waving a wrench with a confident smile.
